jsDoc.doc:
Proxy type of {@code Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>} or {@code Uint8Array} in TypeScript 5.7 or below respectively.

This type is internal utility type and should not be used directly.
Concatenate an array of byte slices into a single slice.

tags.name: buffers
tags.doc: Array of byte slices to concatenate.
A new byte slice containing all the input slices concatenated.

jsDoc.doc:
Copy bytes from the source array to the destination array and returns the
number of bytes copied.

If the source array is larger than what the `dst` array can hold, only the
amount of bytes that fit in the `dst` array are copied.

tags.name: src
tags.doc: Source array to copy from.

tags.name: dst
tags.doc: Destination array to copy to.

tags.name: offset
tags.doc:
Offset in the destination array to start copying to. Defaults
to 0.
Number of bytes copied.

jsDoc.doc:
Returns `true` if the suffix array appears at the end of the source array,
`false` otherwise.

The complexity of this function is `O(suffix.length)`.

tags.name: source
tags.doc: Source array to check.

tags.name: suffix
tags.doc: Suffix array to check for.

`true` if the suffix array appears at the end of the source array,
`false` otherwise.

jsDoc.doc: Check whether byte slices are equal to each other.

tags.name: a
tags.doc: First array to check equality.

tags.name: b
tags.doc: Second array to check equality.
`true` if the arrays are equal, `false` otherwise.

jsDoc.doc:
Determines whether the source array contains the needle array.

The complexity of this function is `O(source.length * needle.length)`.

tags.name: source
tags.doc: Source array to check.

tags.name: needle
tags.doc: Needle array to check for.

tags.name: start
tags.doc:
Start index in the source array to begin the search. Defaults to
0.

`true` if the source array contains the needle array, `false`
otherwise.

jsDoc.doc:
Returns the index of the first occurrence of the needle array in the source
array, or -1 if it is not present.

A start index can be specified as the third argument that begins the search
at that given index. The start index defaults to the start of the array.

The complexity of this function is `O(source.length * needle.length)`.

tags.name: source
tags.doc: Source array to check.

tags.name: needle
tags.doc: Needle array to check for.

tags.name: start
tags.doc:
Start index in the source array to begin the search. Defaults to
0.

Index of the first occurrence of the needle array in the source
array, or -1 if it is not present.

jsDoc.doc:
Returns the index of the last occurrence of the needle array in the source
array, or -1 if it is not present.

The complexity of this function is `O(source.length * needle.length)`.

tags.name: source
tags.doc: Source array to check.

tags.name: needle
tags.doc: Needle array to check for.

tags.name: start
tags.doc:
Start index in the source array to begin the search. Defaults to
`source.length - 1`.

Index of the last occurrence of the needle array in the source
array, or -1 if it is not present.

jsDoc.doc:
Returns a new byte slice composed of `count` repetitions of the `source`
array.

tags.name: source
tags.doc: Source array to repeat.

tags.name: count
tags.doc: Number of times to repeat the source array.

A new byte slice composed of `count` repetitions of the `source`
array.

jsDoc.doc:
Returns `true` if the prefix array appears at the start of the source array,
`false` otherwise.

The complexity of this function is `O(prefix.length)`.

tags.name: source
tags.doc: Source array to check.

tags.name: prefix
tags.doc: Prefix array to check for.

`true` if the prefix array appears at the start of the source array,
`false` otherwise.
